subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Identificar e associar progressões aritméticas (PA) a funções afins de domínios discretos, para análise de propriedades, dedução de algumas fórmulas e resolução de problemas.

components.description_pt: Identificar uma progressão aritmética como sequência com razão constante
components.description_en: Identify an arithmetic progression (AP) as a sequence with a constant common difference
components.cc_component_description: Write a recursive formula for an arithmetic sequence in a real-world context

components.description_pt: Conectar progressões aritméticas a funções lineares definidas em domínios discretos
components.description_en: Connect arithmetic progressions to linear functions defined on discrete domains
components.cc_component_description: Demonstrate that linear functions grow by equal differences over equal intervals

components.description_pt: Deduzir a fórmula do termo geral de uma progressão aritmética
components.description_en: Derive the general term formula for an arithmetic progression
components.cc_component_description: Write a recursive formula for an arithmetic sequence in a real-world context

components.description_pt: Resolver problemas usando propriedades e fórmulas de progressões aritméticas
components.description_en: Solve problems using properties and formulas of arithmetic progressions

cc_matches.description: Write arithmetic and geometric sequences both recursively and with an explicit formula, use them to model situations, and translate between the two forms.
Prove that linear functions grow by equal differences over equal intervals, and that exponential functions grow by equal factors over equal intervals.

Identify arithmetic patterns (including patterns in the addition table or multiplication table), and explain them using properties of operations. *For example, observe that 4 times a number is always even, and explain why 4 times a number can be decomposed into two equal addends.*

prerequisites.description_pt: Investigar e registrar, por meio de um fluxograma, quando possível, um algoritmo que resolve um problema.
